svg.title: SLU-PP-332: what has actually been tested
svg.desc: SLU-PP-332: what has actually been tested. Exercise endurance: Mice ran about 70% longer after a week of injections (6 mice per group). Verdict: Mice only. Weight and fat: Obese mice weighed about 12% less after 28 days; lean mice's weight did not change. Verdict: Mice only. Heart failure, aging kidneys: Benefits in a mouse heart-failure model and in 21-month-old mice. Verdict: Mice only. Human muscle: Muscle cells from 10 inactive women, treated in a dish. Verdict: Cells only. Human trials: None found in ClinicalTrials.gov or PubMed. Verdict: None. Safety in people: Never tested; short mouse studies reported no overt toxicity. Verdict: Unknown. Taken by mouth: Its developers report it lacks oral bioavailability. Verdict: Not shown. Sport: WADA lists it as prohibited at all times from January 1, 2027. Verdict: Banned in 2027.
